targets.title: Layers of the skin
targets.description: 5.a Compare the structures and functions of the layers of the skin.

targets.title: Keratinization
targets.description: 5.b Describe the keratinization process that produces a barrier resistant to abrasion and water loss.

targets.title: Ultraviolet radiation and the skin
targets.description: 5.c Explain the effects of ultraviolet radiation on the skin.

targets.title: Skin glands and the acid mantle
targets.description: 5.d Describe the glands of the skin, their secretions, and the functions of these secretions, including the surface film (acid mantle).

targets.title: Temperature, sensation, and skin repair
targets.description: 5.e Describe how the integumentary system regulates body temperature, supports sensation, and responds to injuries through repair processes.

targets.title: Functions of the skeletal system
targets.description: 6.a Describe the functions of the skeletal system.

targets.title: Bone tissue and bone cells
targets.description: 6.b Explain the composition, organization, and functional characteristics of bone tissue, including bone matrix, spongy and compact bone, and the roles of osteoblasts, osteoclasts, and osteocytes.

targets.title: Bone growth, remodeling, and calcium
targets.description: 6.c Describe bone growth, remodeling, and the role of bone in calcium homeostasis.

targets.title: Axial and appendicular skeleton
targets.description: 6.d Identify the components and functions of the axial and appendicular skeleton.

targets.title: Bone landmarks
targets.description: 6.e Relate major bone landmarks to their functions.

targets.title: Vertebrae
targets.description: 6.f Explain differences in structure and function among various vertebrae.

targets.title: Joints and movements
targets.description: 6.g Describe the different types of joints, how they work, and apply appropriate movement terminology to joint functions.

targets.title: Skull development and male vs. female skeletons
targets.description: 6.h Discuss skull development and describe skeletal differences between males and females.

targets.title: Muscle tissue
targets.description: 7.a Describe the characteristics and functions of muscular tissue.

targets.title: Types of muscle contractions
targets.description: 7.b Distinguish among the different types of muscle contractions.

targets.title: Muscle fiber types and performance
targets.description: 7.c Relate types of muscle fibers to muscular performance.

targets.title: Major skeletal muscles and actions
targets.description: 7.d Identify the major human skeletal muscles and their actions.

targets.title: Origin, insertion, and muscle roles
targets.description: 7.e Define origin, insertion, agonist and antagonist, prime mover and synergist.
